bytes.ErrTooLarge.reason: Standard-library buffer-size sentinel in the approved bytes leaf. The kernel does not reference it; any new reference requires a use-golden review.

context.Canceled.reason: Standard-library cancellation sentinel returned by the approved context contract. Application code must not rebind standard-library sentinels.

context.DeadlineExceeded.reason: Standard-library deadline sentinel returned by the approved context contract. Application code must not rebind standard-library sentinels.

crypto/rand.Reader.reason: Reviewed standard-library entropy source behind the kernel's existing crypto/rand.Read calls. No application callback globals are approved.
